refnamediv.refpurpose: Buffer data into a matrix of signal frames.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [y] = buffer(x, n) [y] = buffer(x, n, p) [y, z, opt] = buffer(...)

listitem.para: Positive integer. Number of rows in the produced data buffer.
Integer less than n. Default is 0.
Specifies overlap or underlap behavior. Can be a vector of length p, the string "nodelay", or an integer between 0 and p.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function buffers the given data into a matrix of signal frames. It supports overlapping and underlapping frames based on the parameters `p` and `opt`.
